title: Q2 Private/VPC Initiative Cadence & OKR Mapping
creator: Maya Chen
description: Quarterly planning ticket to define cadence, milestones, and OKR alignment for Private (VPC + on-prem) enterprise features in Q2. This doc centralizes scope, cross-team responsibilities, pilot milestones, and gating criteria for GA. The goal is to deliver a predictable set of private deployment features with clear telemetry and rollout plans so sales and CS can confidently onboard customers with compliance requirements.
okrs: OKR-1: Reduce private deployment time-to-onboard from 6 weeks to 3 weeks by end of Q2 - initiatives: streamlined installer, preflight checks, onboarding docs
OKR-2: Achieve 99.95% SLA target for Dedicated & Private in primary regions - initiatives: autoscaling policies, multi-AZ routing
OKR-3: Decrease per-token inference cost by 15% for on-prem targets through quantization and optimized kernels
milestones: 2025-03-15: Complete installer proof-of-concept and preflight checklist
2025-04-01: First pilot deployment with two reference customers (BankingCorp, HealthEdge)
2025-05-10: Telemetry + audit logging GA for Private control plane
2025-06-10: Security & compliance sign-off and readiness review
2025-06-30: GA feature flag rollout to enterprise accounts
acceptance_criteria: Installer runs end-to-end in customer VPC with documented preflight results
KV cache and batching telemetry present in Console for pilot orgs
Automated upgrade path validated in staging and one on-prem pilot
Audit logs and KMS integration verified with customer-supplied HSM in pilot
Runbooks and rollback playbooks published and reviewed by SRE
risks: Installer complexity: customer network/topology variability may require additional time
Third-party KMS/HSM integration edge cases could delay compliance sign-off
Performance regressions from kernel changes affecting latency SLOs
Sales timing: pilot customers may require bespoke contract terms
tasks: Finalize installer UX flows with Design (owner: DES-210)
Define autoscaling SLO targets and test harness (owner: ENG-4321)
Pilot onboarding checklist and runbook (owner: PM-7642)
Legal/security contract templates for pilots (owner: Legal-INTF)
Pricing note for private deployments during pilot (owner: RevOps)
